key_insight: C3PRO turns cell-centered pathology patches into interpretable phenotypes and spatial motifs that match black-box multiple-instance learning for PDAC prediction while adding pathologist-readable explanations.
clinical_relevance: This could improve trust and auditability of pancreatic cancer biopsy predictions for diagnosis, survival, and resectability without sacrificing performance.
method: Extracted embeddings from cell-centered tiles using a pathology foundation model
Clustered recurrent morphological phenotypes into a visual vocabulary and built a spatial graph of motif patterns
Benchmarked against four MIL models for diagnostic, survival, and resectability prediction
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 809 patients (825 diagnostic biopsies) with nested cross-validation, reaching AUC 0.958 for diagnosis, 0.617 for survival, and 0.696 for resectability, on par with top baselines.
watch_item: The phenotype vocabulary and pathologist annotations still require external validation across sites, scanners, and broader patient cohorts before routine use.
paper_title: An interpretable cell-centric representation of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma matches multiple-instance learning for clinical outcomes and leads to novel pathologist-driven histological biomarkers
